Based on the provided evidence, the minimum Capital Adequacy Ratio (CRAR) required for banks (including scheduled commercial banks) is **15 per cent** on an ongoing basis [RBI_RBI_2008-09_302.DBOD.No.BP.BC.89_21.04.141_2008-09_dated_December_1__2008___753097d3_chunk_13].

This requirement is also explicitly stated for Small Finance Banks, which are a category of scheduled commercial banks, noting that they are required to maintain a minimum capital adequacy ratio of **15 per cent** of its risk weighted assets (RWA) on a continuous basis [RBI_Reserve_Bank_of_India__Small_Finance_Banks___Licensing__Guidelines__2025__00ce7918_chunk_20].
